subject: world_language
concept: Describing daily routines using simple present-tense verbs in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A2 'describe routine activities' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student acts out a daily routine action while saying the matching verb phrase in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences daily-routine picture cards and labels each with the correct verb phrase
exercise.abstract: Student writes or says a sentence describing part of their daily routine in the target language

misconception_flags: uses incorrect verb conjugation for the subject (e.g. mismatched person/number)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
